observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf encodes each canonical molecule by uniformly mean-pooling all non-padding recurrent states and normalizing the result, so a molecule's fixed-width GP coordinates retain an uncontrolled component associated with how many canonical tokens were averaged. The rest of the path is operational across three seeds—all 450 exact fits are positive definite and assimilate every observation—but disposable optimization improves paired surrogate reward in only 305 of 435 rounds, with pooled sitagliptin_mpo lift only 0.00011006466612005493, while macro score still varies from 0.513626533890974 to 0.575798548411393. The evidence does not establish length as the cause, making it the registered intermediate test rather than an assumed fact. A prior attempt to improve corpus support, n-dab88c5af357, selected the same terminal checkpoint on every preparation and changed neither support nor score. The graph-equivalent surrogate intervention n-f851988d522a reduced within-graph disagreement but lowered seed-0 macro by 0.15944257826084401 and weakened expected-improvement lift, so multiplying labeled views is not an adequate remedy for the Parent's representation geometry.
hypothesis: Residualize the frozen canonical-SMILES representation against one corpus-estimated token-length axis: after otherwise unchanged prior training, estimate the direction in normalized mean-pooled recurrent space that covaries with sequence length, serialize it, and project every single-view embedding orthogonally away from that direction before final normalization.
method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.
